title: c-PCR-009 Flat glass products (EN 17074:2019)
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: PDF p5 confirms version 1.0.0, published 2025-04-09, valid until 2030-04-07; update initiated if a new EN 17074 is released. The PDF contains no 'under revision' notice; the under-revision status was reported by the requester (current version applies until replaced). environdec.com page captured in session shows status 'Registered', registration number 2019:14-c-PCR-009.

depends_on_unavailable: EN 17074:2019 (entire normative content: declared/functional unit incl. glass thickness basis, modules, technical data, scenarios, RSL, cut-off/allocation specifics)
EN 572-1:2012+A1:2016 (definition of basic glass products for scope check)

rules.title: Basic glass product per EN 572-1
rules.requirement: The c-PCR covers basic glass products according to EN 572-1:2012+A1:2016; the EPD should identify the product as such so scope can be verified.

rules.title: UN CPC class 3711 (indicative)
rules.requirement: UN CPC class 3711 is identified as relevant, but the category is only a subset of it and also covers flat glass outside it, so a different code is not a non-conformity.

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-009 by registration number
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its registration number (c-PCR-009).

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-009 by name
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include the c-PCR name.

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-009 version
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its version number (1.0.0 for this ruleset).

rules.title: Used together with PCR 2019:14
rules.requirement: The c-PCR cannot be used on its own; it shall be applied together with PCR 2019:14 Construction products, so the EPD must also reference PCR 2019:14 (any valid version).

rules.title: Used together with EN 15804
rules.requirement: The c-PCR shall be applied together with EN 15804; the EPD must state conformance with EN 15804.

rules.title: EPD states conformance with EN 17074:2019
rules.requirement: Standards conformance for this c-PCR is EN 17074:2019; modules, LCA rules and EPD content follow PCR 2019:14 and EN 17074:2019, so the EPD should name EN 17074 as applied.

rules.title: c-PCR-009 v1.0.0 is valid at date of issue
rules.requirement: Version 1.0.0 was published 2025-04-09 and is valid until 2030-04-07; an EPD citing it should be issued within that window.

rules.title: EN 15804+A2 takes precedence over EN 17074
rules.requirement: EN 17074:2019 was written for the older EN 15804; where they differ, EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021 prevails, so the EPD must be based on EN 15804+A2.

manual_checks.title: Product is a basic glass product within EN 17074 scope
manual_checks.reason: Scope is limited to basic glass products per EN 572-1 'as stated in EN 17074:2019'; whether processed glass (coated, laminated, toughened, IGUs) is covered depends on the unavailable standard.

manual_checks.title: Type of EPD and information modules per EN 17074:2019
manual_checks.reason: The c-PCR only says 'as in PCR 2019:14 and EN 17074:2019'. Any module restrictions, mandatory modules or allowed EPD types beyond the parent PCR are defined in EN 17074:2019, which is not available; a reviewer must check them.

manual_checks.title: LCA methodology per EN 17074:2019
manual_checks.reason: Declared/functional unit, system boundary, cut-off, allocation, default scenarios, RSL and any product-specific calculation rules are delegated to EN 17074:2019, including the reference thickness/area basis of the declared unit. Not encoded because the standard is not available.

manual_checks.title: EPD content and format per EN 17074:2019
manual_checks.reason: Technical data to declare, additional information and any extra reporting/statements are delegated to EN 17074:2019; verify manually against the standard.

manual_checks.title: Deviations from 'should' recommendations justified
manual_checks.reason: Any deviation from a recommendation shall be justified in the EPD development process; whether a justification is adequate needs human judgement.

manual_checks.title: Resolve EN 17074 vs EN 15804+A2 conflicts
manual_checks.reason: Wherever EN 17074:2019 (based on EN 15804+A1) differs from EN 15804+A2 (e.g. indicator set, mandatory C1-C4 and D modules, biogenic carbon reporting), A2 governs. Identifying each conflict requires the standard and human review.

notes: Apart from scope and administrative data, every substantive section of this c-PCR (2.2.2 type of EPD/modules, 2.2.3 geography, 2.2.4 EPD validity, 4 LCA rules, 5 EPD content, 6 glossary) only says 'as in PCR 2019:14' and/or the EN standard. Rules from PCR 2019:14 are covered by parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 and are not repeated here.
No defaults are given in the c-PCR itself; all default scenarios/values live in the unavailable EN standard or in the parent PCR, hence 'defaults' is empty.

Section 1.2 allows use with any valid version of PCR 2019:14 regardless of the version cited in the c-PCR, so pairing with parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 is acceptable. No override of parent PCR rules is stated in this c-PCR.
The PCR was developed within CEN and adopted without extra open consultation or review (section 3); PCR moderator and committee are 'not applicable'.
REF.01-REF.04 and STD.01 search the full rendered EPD text (document.text); no doc_section is set to avoid depending on section naming.

VAL.01 compares ISO-8601 date strings lexicographically (expression string literals are an extension of the README syntax); it is derived from the c-PCR publication/validity dates and the GPI principle that a valid PCR must be used.
Obligation semantics (section 1.1): 'shall' = requirement, 'should' = recommendation whose deviation must be justified, 'may'/'can' = permitted option.

Override recorded: section 2.1 states EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021 takes precedence over EN 17074:2019 in case of discrepancies (EN 17074 was based on the older EN 15804). This is not an override of PCR 2019:14 but of the referenced EN standard.
Declared/functional unit (e.g. 1 m2 of glass at a stated thickness) is not given in the c-PCR; it is defined in EN 17074:2019 - not available. No unit or mass-per-m2 formula check is encoded.

Ambiguity: scope says 'basic glass products according to EN 572-1 ... as stated in EN 17074:2019', whereas the EN 17074 title covers 'flat glass products'; whether processed/transformed glass is in scope cannot be resolved without the standard.
Discrepancy with request: the PDF has no 'under revision' statement; status_note records the requester's information.
Version history (section 8): 2021-01-25 original, 2024-04-30 validity alignment and reference updates, 1.0.0 (2025-04-09) prolonged validity and switch to version numbers.
New field paths introduced: product.un_cpc_class (4-digit UN CPC class derived from product.classification_codes[]).
